maria: Quick 30s poll — what's your go-to pairing when you're deep in code? React or reply with one of: :coffee: coffee / :tea: tea / :zap: energy drink / :droplet: water / :cookie: snack

ash: :coffee: coffee all day. black.

lee: :tea: green tea for me, but a cookie on Fridays :cookie:

sam: :droplet: water + occasional :zap: when the deadline looms

chris: :cookie: snacks > liquids. chips, 10/10.

anya: :coffee: but iced in summer. also :sleeping: when it's 3pm

maria: tallying — so far coffee 2, tea 1, water 1, snack 1, energy 1

dev-bot: Poll closed? (jk) — if we get 3 more I'll cook up a chart :bar_chart:

ash: not voting but — mandatory reminder: label your mugs!

lee: Also, where do we stand on office espresso machine? :coffee: :machine: (totally lobbying)

sam: +1 for espresso. will bring biscotti.

maria: OK OK petition started. I'll drop a Google form in #office-logistics if folks want to actually fund it :grin:

chris: :thumbsup:

anya: :heart:
